name: PageWire
description: Web pages for AI agents: turn any public URL into clean Markdown with title, description and links, extract page metadata (OpenGraph, Twitter card, JSON-LD, canonical URL, language, icons), or read a page plus up to 4 same-host linked pages. No API key or account: each tool call is paid per call in USDC via x402 (Base or Solana) or MPP (Tempo).
author: PageWire
